profile.headline: Senior Embedded Software Engineer at Kubota

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Provided low-level software support for self-steering and autonomous tractor products.
•	Developed custom boot loaders with 
•	Developed STM32-based motor control software to convert CANBUS commands to steering control and provide real-time position feedback.
•	Designed communication protocols for CANBUS compatible motors.
•	Performed board bringup for custom Variscite-based Engine Control Units (ECUs). Developed custom Yocto-based Linux images for ECUs.  
•	Implemented secure boot for linux-based ECUs.
•	Developed software test suites for prototype hardware.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Board Development · Linux · Embedded Devices

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led initiatives to improve sensor maintenance and reliability including:
•	Developed AWS IoT based sensor update infrastructure that cut the labor to update the Density sensor fleet by over 90%. Development included on-sensor update code,  AWS IoT configuration, and an Elixir/Phoenix based management app.
•	Developed OpenTelemetry-based tracing and monitoring, an OpenTelemetry collector customized for our embedded sensors, integrating the output with Honeycomb for monitoring.
•	Developed sensor based health metrics and monitoring.
•	Maintained embedded systems and web services using C, C++, and Python. 
•	Worked on board bringup for new products.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software · C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Elixir

positions.title: Senior Staff Engineer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for release planning and feature selection.
•	Responsible for machine learning API design and coordinating requirements between product groups.
•	Develop proof of concept machine learning implementations on prototype hardware.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Technical Lead, Platform

•	Lead performance improvement efforts to enable running computer vision based products on lower cost product lines enabling sales to sell analytics into a wider range of opportunities.
•	Mentor engineers and lead code reviews. 
•	Set and implement release engineering policies.  Coordinate development of multiple camera products to maximize code reuse and minimize contention.  Instruct engineers on how to leverage configuration management to support software engineering.
•	Coordinate firmware releases using git, mercurial, and cmake.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Platform Engineer:

•	Adapted computer vision algorithms from R&D prototypes to production software for new camera models.
•	Developed a custom Linux distribution and BSP package for a new embedded video recording appliance using the Yocto build framework.  Developed customized firmware installation and upgrade software to simplify manufacturing and allow robust field upgrades. 
•	Designed and developed custom GRUB bootloader modules to validate firmware and implement factory restore capabilities.
•	Implemented custom PXE based manufacturing process for new product platform.  Integrated manufacturing test and centralized quality reporting capabilities.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
SDK and Integration Engineer

•	Developed and maintained a REST Web API for VideoIQ’s core camera products.  Documented and packaged camera APIs into an easy to use SDK.  Provided telephone and email support for SDK users.
•	Integrated VideoIQ cameras and encoders with third party Video Management Systems (VMS) using C++, C#, and Java.  Developed a portable camera management service using C# and ASP.Net Web API.  Worked closely with VideoIQ sales to provide pre- and post-sales support for large customers integrating VideoIQ products into existing security systems.  Managed certification efforts with VMS vendors.
•	Implemented embedded camera middleware using Java, Linux and Nginx.  Features included a web interface for basic configuration and video viewing and support for pan/tilt/zoom hardware.
•	Developed VideoIQ customer support policies, handled level one support calls, trained and hired the current support department.  Coached support engineers and handled customer escalations.
•	Acted as release engineer, developed build and branch policies, wrote and maintained installation programs.
